assertion: The U.S. unemployment rate remained at a one-year low of 4.1% in August 2026.
sql: SELECT "year", "period", value FROM econ.employment_statistics WHERE series = 'LNS14000000' AND "year" IN (2025,2026) ORDER BY "year", "period"

assertion: Nonfarm payrolls increased by 162,000 in August 2026.
sql: SELECT "year", "period", value FROM econ.employment_statistics WHERE series = 'CES0000000001' AND "year" IN (2025,2026) ORDER BY "year", "period"
